highConfidenceFindings.finding: For a 15-year-old, the keyed option says "consent or assent", leaving the required minor-consent process ambiguous and allowing either component to stand alone. highConfidenceFindings.finding: Each item makes an anti-doping-rules/compliance claim but is keyed only to "clinical-sports-nutrition-burke".
